framework: native PyTorch/Transformers; explicit deviation from authors' EasyR1 implementation
precision: BF16 weights and computation; FP32 CPU optimizer master weights and states
optimizer: AdamW via native torch on CPU FP32 master parameters
voting_tie: lexicographic among valid most frequent answers
response_mask: generated tokens including first EOS; no prompt/padding tokens
policy_logprob: raw model softmax; generation temperature/top-p apply only during sampling
image_processing: original model processor defaults; use_fast=false; no image truncation/resolution override
checkpoint: atomic full FP32 masters, AdamW states, RNG and cursor; two retained per run
probe_decoding: greedy with model modes and RNG restored
zero_advantage_policy: retain original band/KL objective and Adam momentum; label separately
all_unparseable_policy: skip update, retain predictions and denominator
reference_policy: separate frozen original base model; reference forward on each current response prefix
loss_probability_convention: raw untempered softmax; no importance correction for temperature/top-p sampling
